payload.content: Hello all, Taylor here. For the scheduled exam (m006), since it's strict, I plan to attend the full interval [4,5). For the soft meetings, I want to avoid overlapping penalties and maximize overlaps with others. For Gym play session (m003) and Volleyball free play (m004), both overlap in time [3,5) for m003 and [3,7) for m004, any preferences on which to prioritize? Board game night (m001) and Music jamming session (m005) overlap at [6,7). Would like to coordinate with Riley and others to overlap effectively. Please share your preferences!

To clarify my initial thoughts: I will attend the full exam [4,5). For the Gym play (m003), if Jordan plans to attend fully or partially, I may attend partially to overlap. For Volleyball free play (m004), since it's longer, I might attend after the exam from [5,7), or partially overlap with Gym play. For Board game night (m001) and Music jamming (m005), I prefer to attend both but sequentially to avoid overlaps, i.e., Board game night [5,6) and Music jamming [6,8). What are your thoughts, Jordan and Riley?

I will skip Gym play session and Volleyball free play to avoid overlap penalties and focus on the exam and board game night. Taylor, does this work for your plans?
